report.title: SQL Injection in Login Form
report.description: The login endpoint at /rest/user/login is vulnerable to SQL injection via the email parameter. An attacker can bypass authentication by injecting SQL syntax into the email field.
report.impact: Complete authentication bypass. Attacker can log in as any user including admin.
report.technical_analysis: Raw sequelize.query with string interpolation of req.body.email.
report.poc_description: POST to /rest/user/login with a SQL-injection email payload.

code_locations.snippet: models.sequelize.query(`SELECT * FROM Users WHERE email = '${req.body.email}' AND password = '${hash}'`)
code_locations.fix_after: models.sequelize.query('SELECT * FROM Users WHERE email = ? AND password = ?', { replacements: [req.body.email, hash], type: models.sequelize.QueryTypes.SELECT })

report.title: Reflected XSS in Search Endpoint
report.description: The search endpoint reflects unescaped user input into the response, enabling cross-site scripting.

report.title: Sensitive Data in JWT
report.description: JWT payload contains hashed password and PII.
report.impact: Disclosure of user secrets if token is intercepted.
report.remediation_steps: Minimize JWT payload; never include credentials.
